comments.author: @thanh267
comments.text: It’s fascinating how a female led society of just 18,000 people manages such a massive ocean territory. Do you think this matrilineal structure could work for larger countries, or is Palau's success strictly tied to its size? Thoughts?

replies.author: @Outland_US
replies.text: Great point. Scaling a clan based system to a country of millions would be pure chaos. But here is the real takeaway: 18,000 people have more discipline and respect for their land than entire global superpowers. It is not about the size of the country it is about what the society chooses to value. If major world powers operated with Palau rules the world would look entirely different today. Do you guys think any big country actually has the guts to prioritize nature over quick profit ??
